verifier: verify r3.1, quality lens q (readability at the game camera), adversarial
head: 4fe1e5714 (measured on a clean detached worktree of this commit, so no other workflow's uncommitted src/sim edits were in the build)
method: Own capture at a seed the implementer did not use: max_units_ab --variants all, seed 61, t 380, RIFT High, three seatings (A ardit,vashil,dunsom,ervet,hesmi; B odrum,burdam,ilsheta,lisvel,marund; C tunlan,sukri,kemdo,nurrow,ulkro), so all 16 fighters were shot (Tunlan and Rishal only as occluded or stealth x-ray silhouettes). Contact sheets are in verify_r3_1_q_seed61_all16.png and verify_r3_1_q_seed61_crowns.png. Crown colour is my own CIELAB D65 median on a hand-placed box over each top in the 200x240 crops. Ruling 32 was measured twice: with the lane's own zone_grade.reserved_pct, and with my own float-HSV code in node (sharp decode of each GLB's _base albedo). I re-read the implementer's lineup_qa pre/post JSONs pair by pair. Budgets: perf_1080 --prod --q high --match-seeds 11 on the clean worktree.

items.evidence: At seed 61 the helm and pack read slate/steel blue: L* 63.7, C 24.5, h 249. dE76 to Vashil's hood (L 73, C 23, h 312) is 26.3, and to Dunsom's hat (L 78.6, C 25.3, h 315) is 30.7. Both are above 25 and the hues are about 65 degrees apart, so the three-way lilac collision is gone. This reproduces the implementer's claim at a new seed. Watch: the coat's periwinkle (L 55.6, C 24.8, h 264) sits only 10 dE from the helm, so the top and middle read as one blue mass (lineup crown break false, dL 0.7). Ardit's sigPct in lineup_qa fell from 18.6 to 9.75 % (gate 6 %). Lisvel's cyan head wrap is 21 dE from Ardit's helm in game (lineup 21.5 at facing 180).

items.id: Hesmi's new aubergine hood moves her into the Vashil/Dunsom purple family
items.evidence: The task was to break Hesmi's cream crown, and the critic asked for hues no one else uses. In game the new hood is a saturated violet: L* 49.7, C 35.2, h 317. Vashil's hood is h 312 and Dunsom's hat h 315, the same hue family, and those two are still near-identical (dE 6.3 in my crops). Hesmi is separated from them only by value (dE 26.6 to Vashil, 30.6 to Dunsom). So the roster again has three purple/lilac-topped fighters. That is the regression class verify3_q failed on Ardit, now created by a different recolour in the same round. The implementer's own lineup data shows Hesmi-Dunsom at facing 180 falling from 33.6 to 23.8, a new failing pair that r3_summary does not report. Hesmi's top value band at facing 180 fell from 64.6 to 35.1, against the bible's 70-85, and her crown break at facing 180 went from true to false. Up close, pale cream crease lines from the old bake run across the violet hood, and the darker hood makes the pale eye-band slit stand out more. That slit is not a sensitivity breach at 1x (it reads as a narrowed eye, not a blank or solid one), but log it for the cards lane.

items.id: Odrum cap and the yellow-green family
items.evidence: The 'deep olive' cap does not read deep in game. At seed 61 it is L* 57.8, C 28.9, h 90, a light khaki-olive. In lineup_qa facing 0 his crown is still near-neutral (L 58, C 5, h 48, break false). Its in-game hue now sits beside Sukri's lemon hood (h 98) and Ilsheta's green hood (h 102). At seed 61, Sukri, standing in grass shade, measured only 6.5 dE from Odrum and Ilsheta 14.3. The lineup under fixed light keeps Odrum-Sukri at 26-28, so the near-collision depends on lighting, but the three tops sit in one 12-degree hue window.

In game it reads as a pale yellow-green at L* 61, C 15.7, h 102, chroma barely above verify3_q's sage-cream (C 16). The albedo moved from C 22 to C 32, but almost none of that reaches the screen, so there is no player-visible gain. Ilsheta still fails 14 crown pairs.

In game the cowl and torso read as a warm oxblood/brick (L* 37.5, C 20.5, h 66), clearly apart from the cream group. The head and mask were untouched (cards lane). His top band at facing 180 went 43.2 -> 35.5, further below the bible's 70-85, which is acceptable for a dark-cowled bruiser but is a value-rule drift.
At seed 61 the pauldrons and crest read pink-magenta and clearly apart from Ardit's blue. The lineup crown is still h 314-315 (it mixes the head), but the Ardit-Ervet pair now passes.

items.id: Roster crown separation gate (lineup_qa, every pair dE76 >= 25)
items.evidence: 73 of 120 pairs still fail, against 83 before. Vashil-Dunsom is unchanged at 11.7 at facing 0, and the collision is visible in game (dE 6.3). One new failing pair was added this round: Hesmi-Dunsom, facing 180, 23.8.

items.verdict: holds on the lane's own measure, margin not robust
items.evidence: zone_grade.reserved_pct reproduces the claims: odrum harm 7.93, burdam 7.62, ardit 0.94 harm / 3.8 ally, ervet 1.53, hesmi 0.03, ilsheta 0.02. My float-HSV code on the same decoded albedos gives odrum 8.45 % (over the cap) and burdam 7.95 %. The pass therefore depends on PIL's 8-bit HSV quantisation, and Odrum is now a zoned fighter held to 8 % outright. The lead should either name zone_grade.reserved_pct as the only binding measure or pay back about 1 point of margin. Dunsom's base is 16.6 % harm, which is under his unzoned baseline rule (16.46 + 0.5) but is the highest in the roster.

items.id: U6 glass, U1(2) ORM bands, U7 head modelling
items.evidence: These were deferred by the implementer. U6 needs a shader slot (programs are at the 40 cap) and U7 heads belong to the cards lane for Burdam and Dunsom. These are legitimate reasons, but the items stay open against par.

At seed 61 every fighter's ring, nameplate and health bar read clearly in blue or orange. No unit body colour competes with the team rings. Ardit's ally-band albedo share is 3.8 %, his helm is h 249 CIELAB (HSV about 204 in the reserved ally band), and in game it reads steel blue next to the blue ring without merging with it. That is a watch item, not a failure.

I saw no tall, pointed or conical hoods and no skull, mummy, mannequin or blank faces. There are no glowing, solid or hollow eyes and no tear streaks in the 16 crops. Hesmi's eye-band slit is more visible against the dark hood (see above), and that is a cards-lane watch.

perf_1080 --prod --q high --match-seeds 11 on a clean worktree of 4fe1e5714 gives a match peak of 444k triangles at 1016.7 s (actors 199k), 271 draws and 40 programs: GATE PASS. The implementer's 506k reading came from a tree with another workflow's uncommitted src/sim edits, and it did not reproduce on committed code. Programs sit exactly at the 40 cap. No triangles were added this round (albedo re-grade only). Bench crops: 202k-253k tris, 140-194 calls, 39 programs. Timing was not measured because the machine was busy.

problems: MAJOR: Hesmi's new aubergine/violet hood (in game h 317) puts a third fighter into the Vashil/Dunsom purple hue family (h 312/315), the same roster-collision class verify3_q failed on Ardit. Lineup Hesmi-Dunsom at facing 180 regressed from 33.6 to 23.8 (a new failing pair) and is not reported in r3_summary. Hesmi's top value band at facing 180 fell from 64.6 to 35.1 (bible 70-85), and her crown break at facing 180 was lost.
Every-pair lineup crown gate not met: 73 of 120 fail. Vashil-Dunsom is still near-identical lilac (in game dE 6.3).

Odrum's cap reads light khaki-olive (L 58, h 90), not deep olive. It shares a 12-degree hue window with Sukri (h 98) and Ilsheta (h 102), and at seed 61 under shade Odrum-Sukri was dE 6.5. In lineup facing 0 Odrum's crown is still near-neutral with no break.
Ilsheta's stronger green does not reach the screen: L 61, C 15.7 in game, about the same as verify3_q's C 16.
Ruling 32 margin on Odrum depends on the measure: 7.93 % with zone_grade (PIL HSV) but 8.45 % with float HSV. Burdam is 7.62 / 7.95 %.
Ardit's helm and coat now read as one blue mass (no crown break, sigPct 18.6 -> 9.75 %), and his helm is 21 dE from Lisvel's cyan head wrap.
U6 glass, U1(2) ORM bands and U7 head modelling are still not done.
Pale cream crease lines from the old bake show through Hesmi's re-graded hood, and the eye-band slit stands out more against it (cards-lane watch, not a sensitivity breach).
scoreNote: Ardit's major is fixed and reproduces at a new seed. Burdam's cowl and Ervet's pink are real gains. But the round traded one same-family collision for another: Hesmi now joins the purple family of Vashil and Dunsom, which is still unresolved. Odrum and Ilsheta barely move at the game camera. The roster gate is 73 of 120 failing, and three of the U-items are still open. The net player-visible gain is real but small: 7.3, below the 7.5 par, with one major. No blocker, and budgets pass at HEAD.
howToReachPar: Regrade Hesmi's hood out of h 290-330. A deep teal-ink or warm russet would not collide, but check it against Lisvel's cyan and Burdam's oxblood. Gate it with lineup_qa Hesmi-Vashil and Hesmi-Dunsom >= 25 at both facings and an in-game hue gap of >= 40 degrees to Vashil and Dunsom.
Split Vashil and Dunsom: one of the two hats or hoods moves out of lilac (Dunsom's hat is the cheaper albedo change if the cards lane's head and mask ownership allows the hat).

Push Odrum's cap genuinely dark (L* <= 40 in game) or move it off yellow (h <= 60 or >= 140, keeping ruling 32), so the Odrum, Sukri and Ilsheta trio separates. Give Ilsheta's hood enough albedo chroma to read at C >= 25 in game.
Put back at least 0.5 points of ruling-32 margin on Odrum (float-HSV <= 8 %), or record in owner_rulings that zone_grade.reserved_pct is the binding measure.
